decisions: PCH is an explicit opt-in harness outside Pi, with zero runtime work before /coding.
Single and Multi share Goal and acceptance authority but use topology-specific execution.
Old public names, aliases, blueprints, phase reports and activation commands are removed.
Cache remains C0 until a concrete provider integration passes live evidence gates.
All release JSON instances are validated by Ajv 2020; syntax-only parsing is insufficient evidence.
Release manifest generators skip dependency and report trees before recursion to avoid unnecessary work.
Memory capture regression coverage is Chinese-only and expands deterministically from a schema-bound frozen corpus.
Only X:\Pi Coding Harness may remain registered as this package source in Pi.
Runtime-directory gitignore patterns are root-anchored; source Module directories with the same name must remain trackable.
Cache C1 is a provider-specific non-mutating observation integration; it does not claim a provider-neutral adapter or a guaranteed 90% hit rate.
A positive provider cacheRead value proves HIT; zero or missing normalized usage is UNOBSERVABLE rather than MISS.
Live leases are reused above half of configured TTL and renewed near expiry; every authority mutation still validates lease generation and fencing in its transaction.
Provider, model, thinking level and context window continue to come only from the user's active Pi configuration.

Development recovery state and its Markdown projection are schema-validated REWRITTEN artifacts but intentionally carry no migration source or destination hash because they reference final manifest hashes.
Only manifests/PROJECT-STATE.json and PROJECT-STATUS.md may be hashless REWRITTEN RUN_ARTIFACT entries; both hashes must be null, while every other REWRITTEN entry retains a source hash.
Do not rerun pch-smoke-prd01-003; use deterministic regressions for its discovered PCH defects and proceed to the single formal eight-task source epoch.
Exclude pch-formal-002 from quality, latency, token and compaction scoring because its model-backed requests were rejected before execution with zero tokens.
The pch-formal-003 raw score remains 6/8; post-run code fixes are deterministic remediation evidence, not retroactive benchmark credit.
Vitest file workers are hard-capped at two so SQLite-heavy release suites remain stable on memory-constrained hosts; this does not constrain PCH product execution.

Repeated reads after a source mutation and repeated validation after changed code or a failed oracle are retained; unchanged status polling, environment probes and duplicate UI projections are removed.
No natural compaction occurred in pch-formal-003, so this run supplies no live compaction efficacy claim.
Single executes authorized WorkCells directly; new Single WorkShards, TaskPackets and WorkerRuns are forbidden.
GoalContract freeze atomically binds exact bounded intake to an immutable AcceptanceLedger.
H3, H4 and H5 are authority state transitions; an invalid route cannot retain write authorization.
Multi canonical apply uses a CAS-backed PatchTransaction journal and preserves external post-prepare edits for reconciliation.
GenerationGovernor is a local repeated-route guard and does not claim to cancel provider reasoning or reduce already generated tokens.
Model-visible transition output carries only the business delta and missing next/health/blocker hints; full status remains a deduplicated Widget projection.
Every authority-changing same-turn Host response must carry a compact fresh ControlFrame receipt that Bridge installs before the next managed action.
GoalContract and Route proposals reject unknown root and nested fields; exact optional Route shapes replace field-name guessing and silent data loss.

Development validation is batched by related defect cluster: focused tests, affected lint/compile and necessary adjacent integration tests run during repair; full release, manifest/hash regeneration, installation refresh and model benchmark run once at the release-candidate boundary.
Benchmark credentials use only participant-specific controller variables; ambient provider variables are not scoring authority.
Every scored stress run binds the full stress manifest hash, including controller, guard, evaluator and materiality thresholds; catalog hash alone is insufficient.

The frozen stress comparison remains Single Agent with max thinking for both participants; Codex cannot run before the PCH FIRST_PASS report is hash-sealed and cannot be resumed or allocated a second run.
The final PRD-01 candidate remains Single Agent at xhigh; only the harder Terraform stress task uses max thinking.
The final PRD-01 run starts directly from the qualified release-candidate source without a preceding release gate, and its run index binds the complete benchmark manifest SHA-256.
STRESS_FULL is a benchmark difficulty class only; PCH authority continues to use the existing PRD specification route with PRD requirement profile and FULL planning depth.

Complex engineering intake is promoted to PRD/FULL only from the conjunction of at least three technical domains and at least two regression-boundary signals; objective length and one keyword never suffice.
A zero-token provider error is not terminal while Pi declares willRetry=true; the runner permits Pi's built-in retry up to a fixed three-attempt ceiling and records retry telemetry.

runtime_source_sha256 binds only the normalized runtime code/build closure and package version; mutable release/development qualification metadata is bound separately by qualification_evidence_sha256.
pch-candidate-prd01-002 is an invalid infrastructure run and must never be scored or resumed.
PRD-01 candidate 003 is the final PRD-01 execution; do not run another PRD-01 model test.
PRD-01 quality and authority-flow results are scoreable PASS, while token and latency comparison is unranked because two user-reported network interruptions forced three process segments.
Pause after PRD-01 per user instruction; do not start the Terraform stress task, Codex reference, or release gate until the user resumes.

RouteRevision transports replacement current/near WorkCells plus changed metadata; Host reconstruction and full finalization remain authoritative, and an unchanged effective execution projection is rejected before persistence.
Provider usage settles from the first complete assistant message exposed by message_end or recovery turn_end; duplicate completion signals are idempotent and missing evidence remains OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.

Single Supervisor reads span the frozen Route while writes remain current-WorkCell scoped; bounded exact edit preimages may replace a separate fresh-read model turn only when uniqueness and non-overlap are proven locally.
PRD-01 repair benefits are deterministic implementation evidence only until a different future model-backed task measures token, route and latency effects.

Final release evidence composes a standalone performance PASS receipt with a full -SkipPerformance project gate so an already-verified hard performance metric is not repeatedly exposed to unrelated disk jitter.
PCH-DEC-ARCH-ROOT: architecture refactoring targets the verified X:\Pi Coding Harness 1.2.1 root, not the stale rebuild root.

PCH-DEC-ARCH-SEQUENCE: deepen behavior Modules behind existing authority semantics first; move foundation imports after disjoint slices integrate; run provider-free deterministic performance evidence only.

PCH-DEC-AUTHORITY-KERNEL: idempotency, version CAS, BEGIN IMMEDIATE, immutable event/outbox/receipt and fault ordering are owned by one AuthorityTransactionKernel used by core, Task Flow and Harness commands.
PCH-DEC-TASK-FLOW-OPERATION-MODULE: TaskFlowOperationLifecycle owns prepare/dispatch/observe/finish/reconcile/attestation/performance transitions behind a minimal Session Adapter.
PCH-DEC-HOST-APPLICATION-PROTOCOL: one frozen 34-method catalog binds typed params/results and fail-closed client/server validation; authority-bound semantics stay after governance registration.

PCH-DEC-FOUNDATION-LAYER: stable clock, crypto, errors, IDs and validation live in the lowest-level Foundation Module; dependency tests forbid legacy primitive seams and repository-to-orchestration imports.
PCH-DEC-MEMORY-V2-BUILD-SURFACE: production-unreachable Memory v2 engine/drainer/ranking/retrieval/telemetry remain ordinary-test sources but are excluded from runtime emit.
Provider-turn request and STARTED attempt are one atomic begin transaction; response settlement remains one atomic completion transaction.
Existing CAS objects take a full-hash verified fast path and never use size or mtime as authority.
Model-visible coding_flow cannot cancel; irreversible cancel and Memory purge require an explicit user confirmation receipt or non-interactive --confirm syntax.
Current-schema lifecycle upgrade skips backup and migration execution only after full semantic authority verification passes.
A startup integrity receipt is bound to SQLite PRAGMA data_version; same-connection recovery reuses it, while any external commit forces full core and Task Flow verification before recovery.
Headless material clarification records OPEN authority first and only resolves through an explicit /coding clarify question_id=option_id command.
Host-projected UI configuration controls footer/widget rendering and debounce without delaying ControlFrame updates.
Canonical test authorities may clone a process-local verified empty migration template; custom fault migrations and performance-root fixtures always execute their original path.

SQLite WAL authority is fail-closed on known vulnerable embedded SQLite releases; supported Node ranges must carry SQLite 3.51.3 or a fixed backport/newer release and the check runs only after explicit /coding entry or lifecycle verification.

A material headless clarification persists a bounded hash-bound envelope with its OPEN decision; Host status may project verified open choices so Bridge restart recovery does not require a new model request.
Timed-out Host RPC tombstones are accepted only until their recorded expiry and are checked at response receipt even when no later timeout triggers cleanup.

Blocking tool preflight, not tool_execution_start, is the authority seam before actual Pi tool mutation; it must return allow only after the OperationAttempt is durably PREPARED and DISPATCHED under the current lease.

A takeover owner cannot continue a prior generation OperationAttempt through an ordinary transition; stale attempts must be terminated through explicit reconciliation before any new mutation is prepared.
The unused worker_wait Host method will be removed because the supported Bridge uses locally cancellable worker_poll and Host request dispatch is serial.

Managed Pi mutation preflight uses one PREPARE_AND_DISPATCH_OPERATION authority transaction; tool_execution_start, tool_start and startToolOperation are not authority seams and the obsolete tool_start/worker_wait protocol methods are deleted.

Canonical PatchTransaction apply, compensation and recovery writes execute inside AuthorityStore.withLeaseFence, which holds SQLite IMMEDIATE ownership across the actual synchronous filesystem mutation and rechecks before each next file.
Release performance evidence is authoritative only for the declared/default deployment data-root volume; process TEMP is test scratch and cannot silently replace that volume.
An OPEN durable clarification is a local recovery gate: no model/provider turn starts before explicit selection, and exactly one productive continuation is sent after all recovered choices resolve.

latest_correction.summary: Bridge recovery no longer starts a model/provider turn while an OPEN clarification is unresolved. Interactive users resolve the durable choices locally before one productive continuation turn; headless users receive the exact slash-command choices, and clarification submission failure fully deactivates the half-entered Bridge.

failed_routes.reason: Do not delete a test fixture while a current release test still depends on its contract, and do not retain assertions against removed verifier step names.
Do not register both the migration source path and the renamed release path in Pi; duplicate extension loading is invalid.
Do not rely on action receipts alone to keep a 30-second lease alive during long provider/tool-free intervals; an active Agent run needs a local heartbeat before lease expiry.

do_not_repeat: Do not rerun a full architecture review after context compaction when its input closure is unchanged.
Do not restore phase-specific activation and dogfood scripts as release dependencies.
Do not infer provider cache misses or benefits from unknown usage fields.
Do not remove a frozen fixture without first updating every current consumer and its replacement evidence.
Do not leave both old and renamed local package paths registered in Pi.
Do not add an unanchored artifacts/, reports/, telemetry/ or other runtime-directory rule that can hide a source Module.
Do not classify normalized zero cached_tokens as a provider Cache miss.
Do not renew a healthy live Goal lease on every mutation; retain threshold renewal and in-transaction fencing validation.
Do not combine Cache prepare and settle latency claims with provider latency or claim observed historical shares as a guaranteed future hit rate.
Do not add PROJECT-STATE.json or PROJECT-STATUS.md hashes to migration/source closure while those files reference final manifest hashes.
Do not rerun pch-smoke-prd01-003 after its hidden quality, authority closure, root-cause audit and deterministic regressions all passed.
Do not resume or score pch-formal-002; its inherited GEEKSPACE_API_KEY was unauthorized and its six model-backed tasks performed zero model work.
Do not rerun pch-formal-003 or rewrite its raw 6/8 score; any user-authorized retest must use a new run ID and frozen source epoch.
Do not remove changed-source rereads or post-mutation fresh validation merely because an audit reports repeated targets or commands.
Do not restore fake SUPERVISOR WorkShards in Single topology for accounting symmetry.
Do not present message_end rewriting, UI hiding or GenerationGovernor as savings for provider tokens already generated.
Do not reuse one turn-start ControlFrame after a same-turn authority mutation; consume the Host frame receipt before the next managed action.
Do not silently discard unknown Contract or Route proposal fields or ask the model to infer optional field shapes.
Do not resume or score pch-smoke-prd01-005; it was intentionally terminated after exposing same-turn ControlFrame and Route proposal contract defects, and exists only as diagnostic evidence.
Do not resume or score pch-smoke-prd01-006; it intentionally stopped at the first stale-frame signal and is bound to the pre-heartbeat 1.2.1 source epoch.
Do not rerun full release verification, regenerate release closure, refresh the Pi installation or restart a model benchmark after each small repair; aggregate a stable defect cluster first.
Do not resume or score pch-smoke-prd01-007; it loaded stale dist and exists only as execution-closure diagnostic evidence.
Do not resume or score pch-smoke-prd01-008; it proved heartbeat continuity and exposed the oracle diagnostic defect before fail-fast termination.
Do not start a model-backed benchmark from an ambient GEEKSPACE_API_KEY or presence-only credential check; require the participant-specific variable and a successful zero-token /v1/models preflight.
Do not treat catalog_sha256 as the complete stress freeze identity; bind and verify the full manifest SHA-256.
Do not run or resume Codex on the frozen stress task before a hash-valid PCH FIRST_PASS seal, or after a Codex stress run index already exists.
Do not run a release gate before the final PRD-01 candidate and do not add a second formal PRD-01 after it; score the next provider-authenticated run directly.
Do not add a STRESS_FULL product route solely to mirror a benchmark class; compare the class through the legal PRD/FULL PCH contract.

Do not force the frozen stress route in the benchmark prompt or manifest when the live deterministic classifier disagrees; fix and regression-test the general intake evidence rule before running the model.
Do not resume or score pch-candidate-prd01-002; the controller interrupted Pi after willRetry=true, so its partial token, latency and quality data are diagnostic only.
Do not terminate a Pi run on the first zero-token provider error while agent_end declares willRetry=true; wait for bounded retry recovery or exhaustion.
Do not rerun PRD-01 after pch-candidate-prd01-003; it completed 26/26 hidden/focused quality and authority closure.

Do not rank the pch-candidate-prd01-003 cumulative latency or token delta against formal-003 Codex as a win or loss; the PCH path contains two external network interruptions and three process sessions.
Do not start STRESS-01, the one permitted Codex stress execution, or a full release gate until the user explicitly resumes after PRD-01 review.
Do not submit a complete Route when next=SUBMIT_ROUTE and a prior Route exists; use submit_route_revision with the changed horizon and changed metadata.
Do not reject a finite model validation timeout solely because it exceeds 900 seconds; clamp it to the authority ceiling without widening that ceiling.
Do not treat the PRD-01 post-run repair as measured token or latency improvement; no new model-backed run was performed.

Do not patch dependency-owned node_modules or claim the Pi 0.82.1 shrinkwrap advisory is a bundled PCH runtime vulnerability; keep the peer boundary explicit and re-probe when a newer Pi release exists.

Do not move authority-bound managed Host payload semantics ahead of ControlFrame binding and GenerationGovernor route registration; invalid repeated routes must remain observable to deterministic governance.
Do not retain obsolete product identities even as negative comparison text in active development state; self-contained release scanning treats the whole active artifact as public surface.
Do not terminate Task Flow separately from its ManagedRun; use the atomic Task Flow/Harness application transaction and preserve rollback coverage.
Do not bind a new objective or intent to a recovered Goal after Host restart.
Do not let slash commands replace the default Memory recall query.
Do not pair a stable Cache partition or family ID with a per-request created_at_ms identity hash.
Do not use Host-side long polling on the Bridge execution lane when cancellation or shutdown must remain prompt.
Do not treat an authenticated response for a bounded timed-out request as an unknown-response attack; match it against a TTL-bounded tombstone.
Do not repeat full authority and Task Flow scans within one unchanged SQLite data_version generation.
Do not open or migrate SQLite WAL authority with embedded SQLite 3.51.2 or another runtime in the documented WAL-reset vulnerable range.
Do not keep the only copy of an OPEN clarification question or its options in Bridge process memory.
Do not accept an authenticated late Host response solely because a tombstone exists; enforce its expiry at receipt time.
Do not model Pi tool_call as occurring before tool_execution_start; Pi 0.82.1 emits tool_execution_start first and invokes blocking tool_call immediately before actual execution.
Do not infer NOT_DISPATCHED from PREPARED state alone after restart or takeover when a real tool could already have mutated the workspace.
Do not let a current lease token continue an OperationAttempt authorized under an older lease generation or fencing token.
Do not split managed PREPARED and DISPATCHED across two Host RPCs or two FULL-durability authority commits.
Do not perform PatchTransaction canonical writes after a one-time lease check; hold the lease fence across each actual filesystem mutation and recheck before the next file.
Do not restore worker_wait or tool_start to the closed Host protocol; worker_poll and atomic tool_preflight are the supported seams.
Do not treat process TEMP placement as deployment-volume performance evidence; fingerprint and benchmark the actual declared/default data-root volume.
Do not unconditionally send the entry objective after Host recovery when open clarifications remain; project and resolve the durable choices locally first.
